name: AHV pension, 25 Swiss years at CHF 120,000, from 63 to 70
workings: Born 1963-01-01; 25 Swiss contribution years at an average income of 120,000.00, 19 years abroad (they count only toward the one-year minimum).
At 63 (2026): average 120,000.00; monthly 2,520.00 for a full record × 25/44 × 0.864 = 1,237.0909; a year 16,082.1818 (13 payments); the first year 11 months and their 13th: 14,742.0000.
At 64 (2027): average 120,000.00; monthly 2,520.00 for a full record × 25/44 × 0.932 = 1,334.4545; a year 17,347.9091 (13 payments); the first year 11 months and their 13th: 15,902.2500.
At 65 (2028): average 120,000.00; monthly 2,520.00 for a full record × 25/44 × 1.000 = 1,431.8182; a year 18,613.6364 (13 payments); the first year 11 months and their 13th: 17,062.5000.
At 70 (2033): average 120,000.00; monthly 2,520.00 for a full record × 25/44 × 1.315 = 1,882.8409; a year 24,476.9318 (13 payments); the first year 11 months and their 13th: 22,437.1875.
Early: −6.8% a year for life; deferred: +31.5% for 5 years. Amounts in 2026 francs (no growth).
